The Tang family, the Shanxing Group, and the families of Zhang Qiaorong and Li Qian were all difficult to deal with.
The Zhang family's Zhang Group was no less capable than the Tang Group, and the Li Group had always been a close partner of the Zhang Group, like brothers in arms.
The Zhang and Li Groups alone were already a bit difficult to deal with, but now with the Tang family and the Shanxing Group, the difficulty doubled.
What the hell was going on?
This time, they didn't meet at the club, but at a newly built factory.
In the cafeteria, Zhao An sat in a chair with his arms folded.
This time, there was quite a stir.
He could provide some technical support, but he couldn't be the first to take action.
He had to find someone to take the blame.
Moreover, these scapegoats were the kind who willingly rushed to the front despite knowing they would be surrounded.
It wasn't out of loyalty, but simply to reclaim what was theirs.
After sitting quietly for two minutes, Tang Bing led a few young men in their thirties to the cafeteria.
The younger brothers stood outside and didn't go in.
The large cafeteria was occupied by only a handful of people, including Zhao An.
Several cases of beer and a few cold dishes were placed on the simple alloy tables to accompany the drinks.
"Sit down," Zhao An said, invitingly.
He picked up the beer bottle, poked his thumb on the cap, and pried it open.
This move caught the others' attention, clearly suggesting Zhao An was a martial artist.
Although in the world of the wealthy, even the most skilled fighters couldn't outperform wealth, physical strength and substantial capital always offered distinct advantages.
"Young Master An, this is Li Tong, the son of the second-in-command of the Li Group," Tang Bing introduced briefly.
"We're both down-and-out people."
Li Tong was a burly man with thick eyebrows and large eyes.
He looked more like a coal miner than a wealthy second-generation.
After Tang Bing finished introducing him, he immediately clasped his fists and said, "Greetings, Young Master An."
"Yes!" Zhao An nodded calmly.
"Sit down."
"This is Bai Cong, the second son of the second-in-command of the Bai Group.
The Bai Group is a large conglomerate, but their main power is still concentrated in the eldest and third-in-command.
The second-in-command, on the other hand, has no power and has been marginalized," Tang Bing continued.
"Greetings, Young Master An." Bai Cong was a bespectacled, refined man, though it was unclear if he was a beast in human form.
"Zuo," Zhao An said, pointing at Zuo.
"This is Niu Li of the Niu Group, and this is Lan Xi of the Lan Group," Tang Bing continued.
"Well, sit down.
I know everything.
Let's eat something first.
I must have called you here for something." Zhao An picked up the beer bottle and said, "I'll finish it.
You guys can do whatever you want."
Bang!
The beer bottles clinked together.
Zhao An said so, but no one, including Tang Bing, dared to actually take a sip of such a big brand.
They all emptied their bottles.
This kind of show of force was really hard to handle.
Zhao An poured the beer bottle down, not a drop left, indicating that he had finished it.
The others also took a swig, each holding the bottle downward to show that they hadn't cut corners!
"Okay, I know you're all unsuccessful people in real life.
You've all done some scumbag things to some extent.
I don't care if my partners are scumbags or saints.
Only those who benefit me are my accomplices." Zhao An began to talk freely, revealing every wrongdoing.
Everyone whose name was mentioned paled.
Secrets, things known only to them, were being revealed, and it was simply appalling.
From masturbating with his sister-in-law's underwear to committing adultery with his subordinate's wife to sending someone to hell—there was nothing Zhao An didn't know.
"This society is fucked up.
If we want more, we need to be stronger.
If you want to take back what's yours, your share, then work with me.
If you ever grow stronger and want to go it alone, remember to tell me.
I'll definitely agree.
I'm not interested in money, but sometimes you have to meet certain targets to prove your ability." Zhao An took out a cigarette, lit it, and tossed one to each person.
"Whatever Young Master An commands, we'll do the same.
I, Old Niu, am a rough man, and they all look down on my crudeness.
As long as Young Master An helps me, I'll follow his lead.
Anything Young Master An commands, I won't refuse!" Niu Li lived up to his name, built like an ox and looking like a rough man, completely out of place among the refined, uncultured crowd.
Furthermore, he wasn't handsome, and was rather ugly.
No wonder he was looked down upon.
"Me too!" Lan Xi also stepped forward.
He was one of the frustrated members.
Compared to Niu Li's stature, he was practically short and thick, and even his family looked down on him.
He hadn't much skill, so being marginalized was a bit unpleasant.
However, as a family member, as long as he lived, he would one day return to the decision-making level.
The five of them clasped their fists, exuding a strong underworld air.
To the uninitiated, they might have mistaken them for a bank robbery.
"Don't be so serious.
Sit down and have a cigarette.
I've been developing something lately.
As you know from the motorcycle industry, this kind of thing needs promotion.
It's brand new, and the food delivery platform will be online this weekend.
We only need a week of feedback.
If we see good results, we'll promote it anyway.
I'll leave the other cities to you.
It just so happens that your family has some influence in the local area, so it's perfect for developing channels." Zhao An slowly explained his plan.
"Young Master An, are we going to do business first?" Li Tong was a little confused.
"If we don't do business, are we going to rob banks?" Zhao An asked, then burst into laughter.
A few people joined in the laughter, and the atmosphere suddenly became less serious.
If businessmen don't make money, are they going to think about dividing up the territory?
What era is this?
Still imitating the tricks of gangsters?
Gangsters don't use their brains, and their lives are just airplanes.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 The Useless Alliance?
paragraphs: "North, East, and West, you three will take care of this. Tang Bing, you can start building a factory later. I'll provide you with the latest information and technology. Remember, this is a lease; these are all patented inventions. When the Tang Group negotiates terms with you, tell them everything; they'll know what to do." Zhao An let out a silent, chilling sneer.

Tang Bing reacted quickly, probably hoping someone within the family would proactively approach Zhao An to negotiate terms. He hadn't yet imagined that his sister had already been anally fucked by Zhao An, including footjobs and blowjobs, with only a hint of virginity remaining.
"I understand. I know what to do. Don't worry, Young Master An." Tang Bing's smile grew smug. This was truly a blessing in disguise!

Although he didn't know the core technology Zhao An had provided, anything patentable had to be incredibly impressive. Did he really think patents were that easy to obtain? That was sheer bullshit. This time, he was sure to capitalize on Zhao An's core patent and make it a hit! Then he'd teach those who looked down on him a lesson: a dead turtle!
The other four people shuddered, remembering that Zhao An wasn't just a businessman, but a genius. A true all-rounder, an almighty genius!

Zhao An puffed on a cigarette as he continued to work on the food delivery platform. Previously, he'd only been focusing on the local city, but now, expanding to other cities, he needed to find local tycoons for help. These down-and-out rich second-generations were just down and out, but they still had the connections.

The reason Zhao An sought their help and partnership was entirely due to his command of people's hearts. These people had all fallen from grace, had once enjoyed a flattering position, only to be defeated in the struggle. This tumble, from glamorous and beautiful to tattered and shabby, was too much for anyone to handle.
Besides, Zhao An knew their secrets. After a good beating, he began tossing out red dates, letting them scramble to eat them.

"Okay, that's all I have to say. If you have any further questions, feel free to tell me. I'll tell you everything I know." Zhao An lit a cigarette, beer in one hand, looking like a drunken hooligan. But his aura was impossible to ignore; it wasn't the aura of a regular worker.

"It's nothing. I regard Young Master An as my boss. I'll do whatever you say, without question. Here's a bottle of wine for you, Young Master. Feel free to do as you please." Niu Li finished, then took the bottle and blew into it. He was a rough man; he could do well if he was asked to follow a plan. Asking him to be the boss and make his own plans would be putting a tough nut on him.

The other three also took their bottles, toasted Zhao An, and blew into them. "After this is done, you'll all own a small stake in Haotuan Waimai. This will be your capital for survival. Let me be clear, I'm easy to talk to. Ask me for anything you want. If you're qualified, you'll have a share. Follow me, and you'll get everything you desire: wealth, money, status, and so on." Zhao An snapped his fingers.
A robotic cart rolled over, carrying a meat grinder and a bucket of pork.

"I personally won't hold those traitors responsible for leaving without a word. I rarely collaborate with others, but there are certain things a genius like me must endure. Just remember this: if you work with me, be loyal. If you don't, tell me." Zhao An picked up a large piece of pork and tossed it into the grinder, blending it. The process was so disgusting it made one want to vomit. It was completely unbearable.

Several people watching also felt nauseous. Watching a large piece of pork being pulverized into a paste was definitely not a pleasant experience. These things are actually plentiful in the market; every pork stall has one.
But this atmosphere, coupled with Zhao An's sinister aura, sent shivers down everyone's spine. This man was terrifying!

Including Tang Bing, no one was immune to the fear of Zhao An. Such a powerful man possessed not only ample funds, a brilliant mind, and a high IQ, but also a ruthless and merciless style of action. Only such a leader could rally people's hearts and gain their trust.

Tang Bing was truly terrified this time. Every time he thought he understood Zhao An, Zhao An would unleash a powerful move. Every time he thought he knew someone, his bottom line would be broken in the next second. This was a ruthless man who would never give his opponent another chance, striking him dead with a single blow, showing no mercy.

Zhao An snapped his fingers, and the machine automatically returned to its original state. "This is just a warning, a familiar story. I've already sent you the detailed plan. Just talk to my agent when the time comes. If there's anything you can't handle, let me know. When you get up, just treat me to a drink. If there's a beautiful woman, I'd be even better. As for what kind I'm looking for, haha, you can ask Tang Bing."
Looking at his watch, Zhao An smiled. "Okay, it's almost time. I have other things to do. Come, let's have one last drink. I wish us a happy cooperation!" He then picked up the bottle.

Tang Bing and the other three also picked up the bottle and drank one with Zhao An. They'd already drunk five bottles of beer in that time, and everyone felt a little bloated. Even drinking water wasn't something they drank this way.

After leaving the factory, Tang Bing and the others gathered at the villa. They gathered to discuss the next steps. Cooperation was a given, but some of the things they would do needed to be discussed.
"Young Master Bing, how did you meet Young Master An?" Niu Li asked, somewhat puzzled.

"Haha, I was thinking of dealing with him at first, but I was lucky enough to survive. Young Master An is amazing. It's hard to say who is behind him, but he must be stronger than all of us. If you want to get back the position of heir and become the one in charge, there's nothing wrong with following Young Master An!" Tang Bing naturally stood on Zhao An's side, and he was almost turning from an unemployed vagrant into a die-hard fan of Zhao An.

paragraphs: "So what type of woman does Young Master An prefer?" another Lan Xi asked. He looked a bit shabby, but he was certainly capable of playing tricks. He'd hit the nail on the head with one sentence, and that was the key!
"Isn't it young, beautiful women?" Li Tong asked with a hint of doubt, clearly puzzled.

"As far as I know, Young Master An isn't picky about women. As long as they're beautiful, he'll be fine. Young women, charming young women, dignified mature women—anyone can find one. But beautiful women have to be virgins. All men like virgins, right?" Tang Bing had no idea what Zhao An liked, but from his observation, he didn't seem to care.
At this point, the men exchanged glances and smiled knowingly. They were all old perverts, so no one should laugh at or criticize anyone else.
After Zhao An gave his instructions, he left. As he'd said, he was still very busy.

During the evening livestream, Xiaoqi was a bit absent-minded. Especially during dinner, she saw her best friend beaming with joy as she boasted to her boss about visiting her livestream, praising her, and sending her rockets.

Perhaps it was an unintentional mistake, or perhaps she was simply sharing her joy. Wu Xiaomiao was quite proud. After all, she was the woman Zhao An had slept with. Housekeeping Manager Zhao Fei had told her to prepare down jackets and other clothing and supplies for their trips to snowy regions, including skiing.

These were perks only available to women who had slept with Zhao An. And it was clear that Zhao Fei had a crystal-clear record of all the women's experiences with Zhao An. As a secretary, Zhao Fei had reached the pinnacle of what a secretary could do. Not only did she have to warm the bed, but she also had to juggle the boss's mistress and personal life. She was incredibly busy.

The price of this busy schedule was an unlimited credit card, allowing for unlimited spending and withdrawals. This credit card is independent of her salary. As long as her salary is paid, the credit card can be used just as it is, without any restrictions.
At least it's rarely used. Besides her mother and Aunt Chai, Zhao Fei is the only one with this privilege.

So no matter how many women Zhao An has, Zhao Fei isn't worried at all. She sits back and relaxes. In a sense, she's the boss of these female streamers. The women outside don't matter to her; she only cares about these slutty streamers in the company!

The thought of her best friend sleeping with her boss behind her back infuriated Xiao Qi. She even lost her focus while dancing. She ended up playing games instead. Her popularity remained low, with only a few hundred people. Even late at night, during the evening rush hour, and still so few people, you can imagine how much of a failure she's been.

And her earnings during this period weren't even as much as her best friend Wu Xiao Miao's in an hour. They livestreamed together, and Wu Xiao Miao is now a well-known streamer. Xiaoqi couldn't even meet the threshold for becoming a "failed" streamer. The gap was obvious, and it was no wonder she was angry and frustrated. She felt her best friend had taken everything she had.

Xiaoqi was furious, irritated, and on the verge of losing her mind. In the midst of her rage, she received a text message. She initially ignored it, but after the game ended and she wanted to check, she discovered it was from her boss, Zhao An, asking her to go to a place that was clearly an apartment complex.

At the sight of the address, Xiaoqi's pretty face flushed. What did that mean? It was obvious they were going for a late-night snack and playing chess. As for the hidden rules of sex, was there even any need to explain it? A single man and a single woman in the same room, if they weren't having sex, were they waiting for love?

After hurriedly ending her stream, Xiaoqi took a taxi to the complex and found an apartment according to the address. As soon as they arrived at the door, it opened. Zhao An, dressed casually, said with a smile, "Come on in! Have a glass of wine to warm you up."
"Thank you, boss," Xiao Qi nodded shyly. Was this what her roommates called "a gift from afar"?
Two bottles of red wine were placed on the dining table, already set. Two exquisite Western dishes were still steaming, likely freshly delivered and still warm.
Zhao An picked up the wine glass and said to Xiao Qi, "Come on, have a sip. Being a livestreamer is hard. I knew that from the beginning. Do you know where you failed?"
Xiao Qi shook her head in confusion. She truly didn't know, and she didn't know what to do.

"Eat something first. Don't starve." Zhao An ordered some Western dishes and began to devour them without any ceremony. Besides the steak, he also had plenty of other filling food, clearly to replenish his energy, after all, he had a strenuous workout tonight.
Xiao Qi ate her steak with some trepidation, finding it quite tasty. She wasn't very skilled with a knife and fork, having barely used them before.
Zhao An smiled, reached out, and expertly cut the steak into small pieces. "Eat."

"Thank you, boss." Xiao Qi's heart warmed, and she gave Zhao An a sweet smile. It was clearly a sweet smile, but on her part, it still held a coquettish, vixen-like allure. Her aura was flirtatious, the kind of innocent vixen with a subtle allure that seduced men. Compared to Zhang Qige's overt flirtation, Xiao Qi's flirtation was more subtle, more refined, and a bit classier.
Zhang Qige was the type of woman many men would mistake for a prostitute. She was incredibly flirtatious, with a strong air of worldliness about her, the kind that couldn't be changed.

A warm-hearted man's behavior was clearly a powerful tool for picking up girls. No woman would refuse the help of a warm-hearted man, and no woman wouldn't crave gentle treatment from a man. Except for some women with masochistic tendencies. "Live streaming isn't that simple. The female anchors are all very beautiful, with all sorts of looks. Some are pure and elegant, while others appear rather coquettish. Each one has a unique characteristic. Do you know what it is?" Zhao An asked.
Xiao Qi continued to shake her head in confusion; she truly didn't know.

"Everyone has their own unique characteristics. Feng Timo has an innocent appearance and can sing, while Zhang Qige is as coquettish as a prostitute. That's all she has. Have you seen any special talents? None! The same goes for Kaka," Zhao An commented, speaking frankly without any bias.
